description: Generate organic blob shapes: a randomness seed plus complexity and roundness controls, live SVG preview, and copyable path code.

faqs.a: Every seed produces a different-but-deterministic blob, so re-entering the same seed and settings recreates the exact same shape.
faqs.q: Can I recreate the same blob later?

faqs.a: Blobs are vector SVG paths — infinitely scalable and sharp at any size.
Blob backgrounds, avatars, hero section art, masks for images — anything that needs an organic decorative shape.

howto: Drag the seed slider to shuffle through blob shapes.
Pick a fill color or keep the gradient.
Click "Copy SVG" to grab the ready-to-use code.
title: SVG Blob Generator
